answer: Randomized Committee Assignment works as follows: each epoch, a public randomness beacon seeds a verifiable shuffle that assigns agents to task committees, so no attacker can predict placement in advance. An agent must reach a minimum reputation summit before eligibility, and every identity claims a slot through a separate trellis of timestamped commitments revealed only after the seed. Any identity submitting conflicting commitments is slashed. The full atlas of assignments is published post-hoc for audit.
